values.rule: anchor_state absent or fresh; or drift non-empty but no entry names a derived anchor (cites never drive state)
anchor_state to_verify or gone and every drift entry on a derived anchor is covered by an open note about the page or one of its sections with the same ref and digest == observed (null for gone)
otherwise, including anchor_state to_verify or gone with an empty drift (a writer that sent no detail)
